It happens after [[Burning Bridges]] ends. ==Cutscene== [[File:TDS Chapter 1- A Growing Threat Cutscene|750px|thumb|center]] ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
As people are being sent to the train tracks by the [[Commander]] and Recruit, [[Hops]] and [[Soldier]] fend off zombies to give [[Demoman]] more time to rewire the timer. Eventually, [[Hops]] hurls a grenade at a zombie, halting their combat while the invasion is ongoing. The [[Commander]] urges the three remaining agents to escape from the bridge right now to mitigate the invasion. Shortly, [[Demoman]] is finally ready to detonate the explosives as soon as possible after the deployment. Thereafter, his detonation device is hit with a sudden error, prompting him to persuade [[Hops]] and [[Soldier]] to escape away as the detonation begins simultaneously. As the two first agents are struggling to grip the remaining ground during the demolition, they fall into water.
